handoffs.message: Implemented shared BFF auth headers: added execute-plans/src/lib/bff-v1/headers.ts (buildHeaders() with Authorization/X-Tenant-Id from a test-injectable provider, storage keys, or VITE_BFF_DEV_BEARER_TOKEN), routed all 5 tradingRoom.ts functions (getTradingRoom, getTradingRoomStrategy, listDecisionEvents, getDecisionEvent, decideOnEvent) through it, kept credentials:include and all existing If-Match/Idempotency-Key/X-Request-Id behavior. Added headers.test.ts (8 tests) and Authorization coverage in tradingRoom.test.ts (7 new tests); npx vitest run src/lib/bff-v1 = 68 passed; npm run gate:agora build succeeded. Note: tradingRoom.ts only has these 5 functions in this repo (no workspace/proposal/widget-revision endpoints), so the task's 'workspace mutation' acceptance bullet does not apply here. PR https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2820 open with auto-merge. Live browser probe of /bff/agora/trading-room + decision-events still needed after merge/deploy during closeout.
